safe_test_strategy: Use designated synthetic accounts and bounded negative authentication controls.
expected_behavior: Invalid credentials must not establish an authenticated session.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Invalid authentication accepted and a protected read independently succeeds.
